title: You Are On God’s Heart
verse: Aaron will bear the names of the sons of Israel in the breastpiece of decision over his heart when he goes into the Holy Place, for a memorial before the Lord continually.
observation: In today’s chapter, we see how the High Priest was to look when performing his duties. The most powerful aspect of this for Christians is that the book of Hebrews in the New Testament calls Jesus our High Priest. We can see many wonderful spiritual parallels between what Aaron was wearing and what Christ has done for us. Perhaps the most striking is when God tells Aaron to wear a symbol of the people over his heart when he goes into the Holy Place. It is to be a continual reminder as to why he is there. He is there to represent the people to God. He was to continually remember the people. This is what Jesus has done for us. His death, burial, and resurrection were for all of us. He had us on His heart when He did these things and continually has us close to His mind. We serve an amazing Savior who loves us more than we can imagine.
application: How does it change your day to realize you are always close to the heart of God?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us the way You do.
